findings.description: The rewritten overflow short-circuit computes `math.log(self.multiplier, self.exp_base)` separately. This raises ValueError when `multiplier <= 0`, and the original `math.log(self.max / self.multiplier, ...)` has the same limitation for non-positive multipliers. Multiplier 0 now fails inside the condition, outside the later try/except.
findings.rationale: Trigger: wait_exponential(multiplier=0, max=10, exp_base=2) with the guard conditions true. The guard is evaluated before the `try`, so math.log(0) raises ValueError (math domain error). Previously, max/0 raised ZeroDivisionError, also outside the try, so the failure is similar but not newly introduced. The change is behaviorally equivalent for positive multipliers, so this finding is low-confidence.
